description: This Java class 'UtilHtml' provides utility methods for HTML validation, parsing, and theme folder management within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for HTML validation with Jsoup, checking unclosed tags with XMLStream, and retrieving theme folder names to exempt.

classes.name: UtilHtml
classes.description: Final utility class for HTML validation, parsing, and theme folder management in OFBiz.

methods.name: createJSoupHtmlParser
methods.description: Creates and configures a Jsoup HTML parser with error tracking.

methods.name: validateHtmlFragmentWithJSoup
methods.description: Validates an HTML fragment using Jsoup and returns parsing errors if any.

methods.name: hasUnclosedTag
methods.description: Checks for unclosed tags in HTML content using XMLStream and returns error messages.

methods.name: getVisualThemeFolderNamesToExempt
methods.description: Retrieves a list of theme folder names to exempt, based on theme XML files, excluding common themes and e-commerce themes.

methods.name: logHtmlWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message related to HTML parsing issues.
